_comment: REAL phantom-column bugs found by verify-sql-column-existence (SELECT references a column absent from the prod schema baseline → 500/42703 on that path; mocked tests hid them). Frozen here as a RATCHET backlog: the guard BLOCKS any NEW phantom column; these are tracked for correct per-case fixes. NEVER treat an entry as an 'accepted false positive' — every key is a live defect until removed. Extended 2026-07-27 when CTE coverage was restored (WITH queries no longer skipped): new keys are CTE-surfaced backlog, not waived defects. Remove a key here as its bug is fixed. | 2026-07-31 PARSER FIX: the unqualified-column patterns lacked a (?<!\.) lookbehind, so a QUALIFIED reference (de.operating_company_id, p.origin_city, rows.length) matched as bare and was attributed to whatever table the fragment FROM/JOINed. 16 keys were pure artifacts of that bug and are removed here — verified individually (e.g. lane-profitability origin_city is a CTE output alias AS origin_city, never a mdata.loads column). The remaining entries were re-measured against an EMPTIED allowlist after the fix and are STILL flagged, i.e. still real. Count is now honest. | 2026-08-01 ACCT-F83: removed sync-conflict-detection.routes.ts#mdata.qbo_customers.raw_payload. It was never a defect — raw_payload EXISTS NOT NULL on all qbo_* mirrors in prod; the schema-parity DDL parser applied every DROP after every ADD, so migration 0213 drop-and-re-add erased it from the baseline. Fixed at source (parser + regenerated baseline), which is the ONLY correct resolution for a false positive under this file contract. | 2026-08-07 SELECT-LIST COVERAGE: every unqualified-column pattern keyed on a WHERE/SET/ORDER-BY shape, so a phantom column that was merely PROJECTED was invisible to this guard. Widening it surfaced 3 pre-existing money-lane defects — same precedent as the 2026-07-27 CTE extension: these are SELECT-LIST-surfaced backlog, NOT waived defects. All 3 were confirmed absent on the Neon prod branch br-fancy-credit-akjnd07a via information_schema with a completeness discriminator (total column count on the same table), so none is baseline drift. Each carries a UNITS TRAP that makes the obvious one-word rename a 100x money error, which is why they are ratcheted for the owning lane rather than renamed here — see the CLS-SCHEMA-DRIFT-SELECT-LIST rows on docs/audit/GUARD-WORKORDERS.md for the per-case fix, including the required cents/dollars conversion. | 2026-08-07 BOL GENERATOR DRAINED: the 7 bol-generator.service.ts keys are REMOVED, not renamed in place — every key here is a live defect until removed, and these are fixed. Both BOL routes (POST .../bol/generate and GET .../bol.pdf) threw 42703 on every call through the shared fetchBolPayload, which is why dispatch.bol_documents held 0 rows. Two MORE phantoms in the same statement (org.companies.physical_address_line1 and .display_name) were never listed here because org.companies is not on this guard 's curated table list — a reminder that draining this file is not the same as fixing the query.
